We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The customer says legal name on invoices doesn't match new registration, need it fixed before audit. According to DOC-003 part 1: legal name, billing address, tax ID are set in Settings → Billing → Company details and are pulled onto every invoice generated after the change. Part 2: Meridian does not reissue invoices already generated; correction applies to invoices from that point forward only. Part 3: Customers who need a corrected copy of a past invoice for their own records, rather than a reissue, can request one through support.

Thus we can tell them to update company details in settings; future invoices will have correct name. Past invoices cannot be reissued; they can request a corrected copy via support. Since they need it fixed before audit, we can explain that past invoices cannot be reissued, but they can request a corrected copy. Provide steps.

We can answer directly. No need to escalate. Provide short answer.

function.arguments: {"message":"Hi there – you can update the legal name (and billing address or tax ID) in Settings → Billing → Company details.
